detail.longDescription: GitHub Actions only redacts values it was told are secret, and ::add-mask:: has to run in each job. An unmasked token minted mid-job is plain text in the log once anything prints it. GitHub's Actions log secret scanning (preview, Nov 9) is a thin backstop: GHEC only, opt-in, no backfill, provider patterns only, no notifications yet. https:// github.blog/changelog/2026-11- 09-secret-scanning-detects-secrets-in-github-actions-workflow-logs/ # DevOps # GitHubActions # Cybersecurity
